facts.fact: Oubangui Médias reports the civil-status directorate (DGDEC), with CIVIPOL, trained agents on 16-17 July 2026 in digitising civil registers, and trained agents have started digitising them into the Registre National de l'État Civil.

CAF.note: The document describes a civil-status register, not a register of the whole population.
